answer: An adversary thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The crystal counter is kept in ridge and opal reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4302 identities would post 2621 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
